dateAssessment: YAML supplies the working calendar span, November 2–6, 1748; no calendar date is spoken. The time extraction is compatible, with incomplete coverage: a ceremony and sunset meeting are followed by the next breakfast and two travel days, ending in late afternoon on travel day two. The windows below bound that same relative sequence within YAML; the opening can fall November 2–4, travel day one November 3–5, and travel day two November 4–6. They do not supply unspoken extra days or independently date each scene. The existing Session 59 note dates the ceremony November 3, departure November 4, and lava encounter November 6; those dates remain competing calendar evidence, pending human review. The earlier month of training, ancient rituals and months of volcanic trouble are background.

watches.summary: The elders bless the expedition and select champions this afternoon.
Sunset meeting; Izzarak’s subsequent night divination is tentatively placed in the same dusk watch.
Breakfast and departure preparations follow the night divination; the agreed morning departure is fulfilled.
The DM explicitly places Kenzo’s examination of the babies at midday on travel day one.
Izzarak recalls waking and rolling his omen that morning, before the river fight.
Late afternoon on travel day two; about two days’ travel, then brief observation and communion.
